study type: Retrospective chart review; pre versus post study
cohort: The study included 1736 women delivering at the Regional Hospital Bamenda Cameroon between 2015 and 2016.
finding: The administration of 600 mg misoprostol in addition to oxytocin significantly reduced the odds of postpartum haemorrhage compared to oxytocin alone, without affecting maternal death or blood transfusion rates.
